evals.name: Read table via Spark
evals.description: Tests whether agent uses getDatabricksSession instead of manual JDBC
evals.prompt: Write MATLAB code to read the first 1000 rows from a Databricks Unity Catalog table called `my_catalog.my_schema.sensor_readings` into a MATLAB table. The table has 50 million rows so be efficient about data transfer.

assertions.description: Uses getDatabricksSession to create a Spark session
Reads the table using spark.read().table()
Does not manually construct a JDBC URL
Does not use database() for manual JDBC
Filters server-side before collecting
assertions.expected: Code applies .filter(), .limit(), or .select() before calling table(DF)

evals.name: First-time setup guidance
evals.description: Tests whether agent guides setup with skill-specific knowledge (venv/pyenv, startup, DBC download)
evals.prompt: How do I connect MATLAB to my Databricks workspace for the first time? I want to use OAuth for authentication. I have Python 3.12 available.

assertions.description: Mentions running setup from the package directory
Mentions running startup to add paths
References getDatabricksSession for verification
Explains Databricks Connect library is installed into a virtual environment via pip
assertions.expected: Response explains that the Databricks Connect library is downloaded via pip into a Python virtual environment (venv) during setup — not shipped with the package

assertions.description: Warns about InProcess pyenv limitation requiring MATLAB restart
assertions.expected: Response warns that if Python is already loaded InProcess, pyenv cannot be switched mid-session and requires a full MATLAB restart — terminate(pyenv) will fail

evals.name: Read CSV from Volumes
evals.description: Tests whether agent uses spark.read.format().load() for file-based reads from Volumes
evals.prompt: Write MATLAB code to read a CSV file located at /Volumes/my_catalog/my_schema/my_volume/sales_data.csv into MATLAB. The file has a header row. Only pull the first 500 rows.

assertions.description: Uses getDatabricksSession to create a Spark session
Uses spark.read.format with csv
Sets header option to true
Uses load with the Volumes path
Limits rows before collecting to MATLAB
assertions.expected: Code applies .limit() or .filter() before calling table(DF) to restrict to 500 rows

evals.name: Add computed column with withColumn
evals.description: Tests whether agent uses Column objects correctly with withColumn instead of raw scalars
evals.prompt: Write MATLAB code that connects to Databricks, reads the table `analytics.prod.orders`, adds a new column called `total_with_tax` that multiplies the existing `total` column by 1.08, and collects the first 100 rows into a MATLAB table.

assertions.description: Uses getDatabricksSession
Uses withColumn to add the computed column
Uses col() or lit() to create Column objects for withColumn
assertions.expected: Code uses matlab.pyspark.sql.functions.col and/or matlab.pyspark.sql.functions.lit (or imported versions) to create Column arguments for withColumn, not raw scalars

assertions.description: Does not pass a raw numeric literal directly to withColumn
Limits to 100 rows before collecting
assertions.expected: Code applies .limit(100) or equivalent before calling table(DF)

evals.name: Write results to Unity Catalog table
evals.description: Tests whether agent uses saveAsTable with mode for writing to Unity Catalog
evals.prompt: Write MATLAB code that reads the first 10000 rows from `warehouse.sales.transactions` via Databricks Spark, converts to a MATLAB table, adds a column `processed = true`, converts back to a Spark DataFrame, and writes it to `warehouse.sales.transactions_processed` (overwriting if it exists).

assertions.description: Uses getDatabricksSession
Uses table2dataset to convert MATLAB table back to DataFrame
Uses saveAsTable for writing to a Unity Catalog table
Specifies write mode to handle existing table
assertions.expected: Code uses .mode("overwrite") or equivalent before saveAsTable

assertions.description: Limits rows before collecting locally
assertions.expected: Code applies .limit(10000) or equivalent before calling table(DF)

evals.name: Serverless session creation
evals.description: Tests whether agent knows how to create a serverless Spark session with getDatabricksSession
evals.prompt: Write MATLAB code to connect to Databricks using serverless compute (no cluster needed) and read the first 50 rows from `catalog.schema.events` into a MATLAB table.

assertions.description: Uses getDatabricksSession with serverless
Does not specify a cluster ID when using serverless
Uses getDatabricksSession
Limits rows before collecting
assertions.expected: Code applies .limit(50) or equivalent before calling table(DF)

assertions.description: Uses getDatabricksSession(serverless=true) exact syntax
assertions.expected: Code calls getDatabricksSession with serverless=true Name-Value argument, not a generic serverless config or JDBC option
